sloka: प्रतिगृह्य च तत् सीता प्रीतिदानं यशस्विनी ।श्लिष्टाञ्जलिपुटा तत्र समुपास्त तपोधनाम् ॥ २.११८.२२॥
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tat sītā prītidānaṁ yaśasvinī ।śliṣṭāñjalipuṭā tatra samupāsta tapodhanām ॥ 2.118.22॥

translations.english: Illustrious Sita accepted the gifts of love and with palms folded in reverence sat beside her, an ascetic.
